title: Crazy real dream
content: I had this crazy realistic dream last night, I had seen in the news (in real life) that military had been knocking on people's doors, asking how many people live there etc (I live in Canada). so I guess that was going on in my dream. So yeah military was going door to door and I don't know exactly what their intention was, but it was not good. It was I think to round up people and clear the houses out, and I think kill the people (or something). I remember seeing a military person signal 'ok this house is good' because it was empty. So anyways, my kids and I tried to escape into the forest, anywhere where they couldn't see us, and there were alot of people also hiding out in the cover of the trees, or by digging underground or hiding under camo tarps. My youngest child ended up getting separated or taken or killed (we didn't really know what happened) and my older daughter and I were trying to find her, whilst also staying hidden and covered. Imagine a huge huge open field, surrounded by forest, we ended up hiding in the forest and finding other people who were trying to survive, with their survival tools and what little food they may have had. Just seemed so real and crazy.. Had a backrooms/waterslide dream the day before, and then this haha
